ranks: Star Trek (TRK) and Star Trek Commander (TRC), completing the set (author-by-set TRK,TRC, 2026-11-14), after the Oracle snapshot refresh that brought the released text (no rulings published yet). 16 of the 35 left authored; the other 19 not reached this session, each recorded with its key.

blocked.name: Dr. Beverly Crusher
blocked.why: Not reached this run (author-by-set B331). Trigger doubling (doubleTriggers) has no cause for a life-gain event.

blocked.name: Q, Stacking the Deck
blocked.why: Not reached. The exiled card gains an activated ability usable only while exiled ("create a copy of this card. You may cast the copy"): no grant of an ability to a card in exile, nor an exile-zone activated ability.

blocked.name: Dominion Saboteur
blocked.why: Not reached. A clone that enters with the same number and kinds of counters as the copied permanent.

blocked.name: Brad Boimler, Eager Ensign
blocked.why: Not reached. A trigger making Pir's counter replacement ("that many plus one of each of those kinds") for its controller until end of turn.

blocked.name: Lwaxana Troi, Charming Guest
blocked.why: Not reached. Granted trigger doubling for another creature's triggered abilities for as long as she stays tapped.

blocked.name: Dr. McCoy, Surly Surgeon
blocked.why: Not reached. Another creature with a +1/+1 counter that would be destroyed instead loses them and has its damage healed.

blocked.name: The Holodeck
blocked.why: Not reached. A static permission to play a permanent card from outside the game (the sideboard, zone outside; PlayFrom has no "outside") or the graveyard once during each of your turns; the client would also need to show sideboard cards as playable.

blocked.name: Ensign Pavel Chekov
blocked.why: Not reached. Each opponent exiles their top X; you choose one land card among each one's own exiled cards, playable while exiled.

blocked.name: Scotty, Miracle Worker
blocked.why: Not reached. Beam me up granted to graveyard cards at their mana cost during your main phase, Scotty excluded as the returned creature.

blocked.name: The City on the Edge of Forever
blocked.why: Not reached. Chapter I's Human token has "Permanents can't phase in": no prohibition act for phasing in.

blocked.name: Marooned
blocked.why: Not reached. Nothing stops the enchanted permanent being returned for a beam me up cost (a prohibition act).

blocked.name: All Good Things...
blocked.why: Not reached; also waits on rulings (none published 2026-11-14) for zero or one card exiled with it.

blocked.name: Võx, Child of the Collective
blocked.why: Not reached; no rulings yet (2026-11-14). Undaunted granted to the next artifact creature spell and the next Spacecraft spell, counting opponents as each is cast.

blocked.name: Gift of Perfection
blocked.why: Not reached. Each opponent reveals until a creature; you assimilate one of all revealed creatures; the rest go to the bottom in a random order.

blocked.name: Cmdr. Troi, Outgoing Empath
blocked.why: Not reached. copy-all of { thisWay: 'cast' } copies only the effect controller's spells; the opponent cast this one.

blocked.name: U.S.S. Farragut, Bold Explorer
blocked.why: Not reached. "Put it on the bottom of your library. When you do, draw a card": the put-on-bottom this-way record covers cards from a hand only.

blocked.name: The Best of Both Worlds
blocked.why: Not reached. Chapter III exiles the Borg chapter I assimilated: nothing links a permanent a chapter gained control of to the Saga.

blocked.name: Chief Montgomery Scott
blocked.why: Not reached. Puts a creature or Spacecraft from hand onto the battlefield with X +1/+1 or X charge counters by its type.

blocked.name: T'Pring, Never Parted
blocked.why: Not reached. "Whenever a creature that fought this way dies this turn, you draw a card": no trigger on the creatures a fight involved.
